title: SEC6: IV copy in SETKEY handler, not in cipher
description: crypto2dev_aes_setkey_ctx() mirrors the iv→aes->reg copy that wc_AesSetKey() normally performs in software but skips when the SETKEY callback returns 0. Placement in the SETKEY handler is correct: (1) the IV pointer passed to wc_AesSetKey() is only valid at that call site — it is a caller-owned buffer that may be freed or reused before the cipher operation runs; (2) doing the copy in crypto2dev_cipher() would require re-exposing the original IV, which is not available there; (3) AES-CBC reads aes->reg at encrypt time, so the copy must happen before wc_AesCbcEncrypt() is called. The alternative (store the IV pointer in devCtx) would introduce a dangling-pointer hazard.
